rows.name: Thaumiel
rows.averse: Duality where there should be unity: two contending heads on one crown. The will to be God rather than to unite with God.

rows.name: Ghagiel
rows.averse: Obstruction of the creative impulse: force with no channel, confusion of beginnings, energy that hinders what it should start.

rows.name: Satariel
rows.averse: Concealment: the veil that hides instead of reveals. Sterile mystery, secrecy for its own sake, the mother who withholds.

rows.name: Gha'agsheblah
rows.averse: Mercy inverted into waste: prodigality, gluttony, dissipation. Giving that breaks the receiver.

rows.name: Golachab
rows.averse: Severity inverted into cruelty: wrath, destruction for its own sake, fire that consumes the one who wields it.

rows.name: Thagirion
rows.averse: The false sun: ego enthroned at the centre. Vanity and ugliness in place of beauty; endless dispute instead of harmony.

rows.name: A'arab Zaraq
rows.averse: Desire scattered: lust that divides rather than unites. Victory picked apart by the ravens.

rows.name: Samael
rows.averse: The intellect as liar: sophistry, falsehood, poison dressed as reason. The Accuser.

rows.name: Gamaliel
rows.averse: The corrupted image: foul dreams, glamour, sexuality severed from meaning. The foundation rotted.

rows.name: Lilith
rows.order: Queen of the Night / the Evil Woman
rows.averse: Matter without spirit: the world as dead weight. Night with no dawn; the whisperers in the dark.
